invoice_url.description: Provider-hosted invoice or receipt document for this payment, when the payload carried one. Absent for checkout-session payments, whose payload has no document URL.

period_start.description: Start of the service period this payment covers. Present for subscription renewals; absent for one-off package purchases, which cover no period.

period_end.description: End of the service period this payment covers. Present and absent under the same conditions as period_start; the two are always emitted together or not at all.
